verdict.rationale: The official Fivetran MCP server documents one multi-item operation: copying existing connections, in the plural, to a new destination while keeping their configs and schemas. That is a narrow, bulk-style workflow an AI agent can run. The REST API is a programmatic building block rather than a bulk-operations feature, and table-level re-sync acts within a single connection, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: general bulk actions across many connections (pause, resync, delete, schema edits), batch API endpoints, documented limits or semantics for multi-item operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Copy existing Fivetran connections to a new destination. Keep their configs and schemas intact or modify them as you like.
Set `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` to `read/write` or `read/write/delete` to unlock write and delete operations
